definitions.explanation: A plant with bright red, spidery flowers that bloom on bare stems around the autumn equinox (お{彼岸|ひがん}), often along rice-field banks and in graveyards.

examples.japanese: {彼岸花|ひがんばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: The red spider lilies are in bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あぜ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{彼岸花|ひがんばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Red spider lilies line the ridges between the rice fields.

examples.japanese: {彼岸花|ひがんばな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ネズミ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植|う}えられた→植える：01210_ueru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Red spider lilies are poisonous, and they are said to have been planted long ago to protect rice fields from mice.

notes:
Also called {曼珠沙華|まんじゅしゃげ}, a Buddhist name from Sanskrit, common in poems and songs.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Named for the autumn ⟦お{彼岸|ひがん}→お彼岸：08933_ohigan⟧, the equinox week when people visit family graves, which is when it flowers. Because it grows in graveyards and is poisonous, it has gloomy associations, and some people avoid giving it as a gift; it is also loved as a sign of autumn, and fields of it draw visitors.

- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧な{彼岸花|ひがんばな}: bright red spider lilies
- {彼岸花|ひがんばな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{群生地|ぐんせいち}: a field of red spider lilies
